name: Defending Sword Mass
body:
Defending Sword, Mass

School evocation [force]; Level arcanist/sorcerer/wizard 9
Effects up to one sword per 3 levels

DESCRIPTION

This spell functions like defending sword, except you can create one sword per 5 caster levels, each of which must defend a different creature within range.
